_doc: The current gaia-testbench benchmark as the autoresearch loop sees it (PLAN.md §2e). gaia-testbench itself has NO version concept, so this is the autoresearch-side source of truth for (a) which task ids the eval runs over and (b) the benchmark_version stamped into every score.json. The teacher (teacher.json) evolves this: it appends a new held-out task id, bumps `version`, and logs the change under `history`. evaluate-config's task fan-out is regenerated from `tasks` by scripts/regen_evaluate_config.py so the object loop and the teacher's rescore always agree on the task set.

history.note: Initial benchmark = the Phase-1 fast-iteration subset (5 of gaia-testbench's 16 tasks). Rationale/evidence recorded in TODO.md Done + Notes.
